title: Signed 4-bit Adder with Overflow Detection
description: Build a gate-level 4-bit adder for two signed two's-complement operands. Tie C_0 to logic 0 and detect signed overflow without using a 7483. Use only 2-input gates from 7486, 7408, and 7432 ICs.
author: Raiyan, Jeneya
hints: Define P_i = A_i XOR B_i for i = 0..3.
Use S_0 = P_0 and C_1 = A_0 AND B_0.
For i = 1..3, use S_i = P_i XOR C_i and C_(i+1) = A_i·B_i + P_i·C_i.
Signed overflow is V = C_3 XOR C_4; it is not simply the final carry C_4.
The gate budget is 8 XOR, 7 AND, and 3 OR gates.
